51105010.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to Schistosoma mansoni His-tagged HDAC8 expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 (DE3) cells by ITC method

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Isothermal Titration Calorimetry (ITC). ITC experiments were done at 25 °C using a PEAQ microcalorimeter (Malvern Instruments). All protein samples were purified in the same ITC buffer (50 mM KCl, 10 mM Tris pH = 8.0 and 0.5 mM TCEP). In a typical experiment, aliquots of 2.0 μL of HDAC8 protein sample at 200 μM were injected into an inhibitor solution at 20 μM placed in the ITC cell. Blank experiments were used to retrieve signal due to solvent (DMSO or DMF) dilution into ITC buffer. Data were analyzed with PEAQ-ITC Analysis Software (Malvern Instruments) and with AffinityITC (Software 4 Science Developers).
original_paragraph.Figure 2 caption: Figure 2. ITC measured affinities and thermodynamic signatures of PCI-34051, NCC-149, and Quisinostat (QSN) binding to hHDAC8 and smHDAC8. ITC profiles of the titration of hHDAC8 (A–C) and smHDAC8 (D–F) with PCI-34051 (A,D), NCC-149 (B,E), and QSN (C,F). Top panels: titration data of the enzymes into the corresponding inhibitor solution. DP: Differential power. Bottom panels: integrated heat measurements for the titration enzyme with the corresponding inhibitor.
original_paragraph.Figure 2 data: The bottom panels of Figure 2 show the integrated heat measurements (ΔH) versus molar ratio. For hHDAC8+PCI-34051 (Panel A), the curve shows a Kd = 75.1±6.9 nM, ΔG = -9.7 kcal/mol, ΔH = -11.0 kcal/mol, -TΔS = 1.3 kcal/mol. For hHDAC8+NCC-149 (Panel B), the curve shows a Kd = 89.6±18.4 nM, ΔG = -9.6 kcal/mol, ΔH = -10.3 kcal/mol, -TΔS = 0.7 kcal/mol. For hHDAC8+QSN (Panel C), the curve shows a Kd = 22.7±3.7 nM, ΔG = -10.4 kcal/mol, ΔH = -12.7 kcal/mol, -TΔS = 2.3 kcal/mol. For smHDAC8+PCI-34051 (Panel D), the curve shows a Kd = 367±40.7 nM, ΔG = -8.8 kcal/mol, ΔH = -9.1 kcal/mol, -TΔS = -0.3 kcal/mol. For smHDAC8+NCC-149 (Panel E), the curve shows a Kd = 81.7±7.0 nM, ΔG = -9.7 kcal/mol, ΔH = -9.5 kcal/mol, -TΔS = -0.15 kcal/mol. For smHDAC8+QSN (Panel F), the curve shows a Kd = 28.4±3.3 nM, ΔG = -10.3 kcal/mol, ΔH = -8.8 kcal/mol, -TΔS = -1.5 kcal/mol.
original_paragraph.Table 1: Table 1 (Figure 1B) lists the IC50 and Kd values for the inhibitors. For smHDAC8, PCI-34051 has an IC50 of 435.8 ± 61 nM and a Kd of 367 ± 40.7 nM. NCC-149 has an IC50 of 95.4 ± 9.3 nM and a Kd of 81.7 ± 7.0 nM. QSN has an IC50 of 303.4 ± 39 nM and a Kd of 28.4 ± 3.3 nM.

assay_conditions.control_method: Blank experiments were used to retrieve signal due to solvent (DMSO or DMF) dilution into ITC buffer.
